picks.name: Classic Cotton PJ Set
picks.say: A shirt and shorts set for fifty five dollars, half off. Only the pale pink stripe is at this price, the other colors are not.
picks.why: Half off, and all eight sizes are still there.
picks.for_who: The friend who wears her pajama shirt as a real shirt.
picks.skip_if: You wanted the darker stripe. That one is not in the last call listing.

picks.name: Pima Long Sleeve PJ Shirt
picks.say: Twenty nine dollars. But this is only the shirt. The pants are another thirty four, so the real price of the set is sixty three.
picks.why: Half off, navy with white piping, sizes XS to 3XL. Harper Wilde says it is cotton.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants the classic piped pajama without paying a hundred.
picks.skip_if: You need the matching pants in XS or M. Those two are sold out. It is final sale.

picks.name: Satin Sleep Tee
picks.say: This is the cheapest thing in the video. Twenty five dollars, it was eighty five. The matching blue pants are not in the sale, so buy it as a top.
picks.why: 71% off. The store says it is stretch satin and machine washable.
picks.for_who: A small gift for a sister. Sizes S to XL.
picks.skip_if: You want a full matching set in blue.

picks.name: Glinda Striped PJ Set
picks.say: Hot take. This is Wicked merch. It was a hundred seventy and now it is fifty one, because the movie moment passed. From far away it is just a pink stripe pajama.
picks.why: 70% off, the biggest cut I am showing. The store says 100% pima cotton.
picks.for_who: The Wicked friend. You know which one.
picks.skip_if: Logos on pajamas bother you. There is a crest on the chest, one on the leg and a print on the back.

picks.name: Modal Sleep Dress
picks.say: A sleep shirt for forty dollars. This is the one I would give my mom. Only the pale pink is half off.
picks.why: Half off and every size from XS to 4XL is in stock.
picks.for_who: Moms, and anyone who sleeps hot and hates pants.
picks.skip_if: You want the navy. It is in a separate listing at 30% off.

picks.name: Bigtime Quilted Robe
picks.say: The splurge. Eighty nine dollars for a quilted robe that looks like a duvet you can wear. Four colors and every size is there.
picks.why: 40% off. Brooklinen lists a cotton shell with polyester fill.
picks.for_who: Cold apartments. It is cut unisex, so it works for a partner too.
picks.skip_if: You run warm. It is final sale.

picks.name: Poplin Piped Nightgown
picks.say: LAKE says twenty five percent off on its homepage. This one is marked forty one percent off in the sale section. Seventy dollars.
picks.why: A sleep shirt with a collar and pockets, 100% cotton per LAKE, sizes XXS to XXL.
picks.for_who: The gift for your mom that she would not buy herself.
picks.skip_if: You might return it. LAKE tags it final sale, no returns.

picks.name: Pointelle Pajama Set
picks.say: My favorite. A tank and wide leg pants for sixty eight, down from one fourteen. LAKE says it is a lightweight knit for hot sleepers.
picks.why: 40% off and LAKE lists it as 100% Pima cotton. All seven sizes in stock.
picks.for_who: Anyone in a warm place. I am in Puerto Rico, so this is the one for me.
picks.skip_if: You want sleeves. Final sale, so check the size chart first.
